fields.name: Hericium erinaceus / Lion's Mane (Whole Fruit)
fields.short_description: Intact fruiting bodies dehydrated at low temperature to preserve hericenones and erinacines.
fields.description:
Grown on supplemented hardwood substrate and harvested at full morphological maturity, these Lion's Mane fruiting bodies are dehydrated at low temperature to protect heat-sensitive hericenones and erinacines.

Supplied as 50 g of whole, unbroken spines, vacuum sealed with a desiccant. Suitable for extraction, decoction or culinary use.

fields.name: Cordyceps militaris (Intact Stromata)
fields.short_description: Vivid orange stromata grown on grain-based substrate, rich in cordycepin.
fields.description:
Cultivated on a nutrient-dense grain substrate under controlled light cycles, these intact orange stromata are dried slowly to retain cordycepin and adenosine.

30 g per pouch. Ideal for infusions and laboratory extraction work.

fields.name: Inonotus obliquus / Chaga (Raw Sclerotium)
fields.short_description: Wild-harvested birch chaga sclerotium, broken into coarse chunks for decoction.
fields.description:
Sustainably wild-harvested from mature birch in cold northern forests. The sclerotium is cleaned of bark, dried and broken into chunks for long simmer decoctions.

100 g per bag. Natural variation in colour and density is expected.

fields.name: Ganoderma lucidum / Reishi (Reserve Grade Antler Conks)
fields.short_description: Large antler-form reishi conks with deep red lacquered caps, reserve grade.
fields.description:
Reserve grade antler-form Ganoderma lucidum grown in high-CO2 chambers, producing dense, deeply lacquered conks with a thick triterpene-rich context.

250 g lot, hand selected. Limited quantities per harvest.

fields.name: Pleurotus eryngii / King Trumpet (Dried Whole)
fields.short_description: Thick-stemmed king trumpet mushrooms dried whole for culinary use.
fields.description:
Meaty king trumpet mushrooms dried whole to lock in their savoury umami character. Rehydrate in warm water for 20 minutes before cooking.

60 g per bag.

fields.name: Trametes versicolor / Turkey Tail (Transverse Slices)
fields.short_description: Thin dehydrated turkey tail slices, ideal for teas and decoctions.
fields.description:
Hand-collected turkey tail brackets sliced thin to expose maximum surface area, then dehydrated at low heat. A rich source of PSK and PSP polysaccharide-peptides studied in immunology research.

75 g per bag.

fields.name: Tremella fuciformis (Dehydrated Fronds)
fields.short_description: Delicate snow fungus fronds that rehydrate into a soft, gelatinous texture.
fields.description:
Pale, ruffled Tremella fronds dehydrated whole. Rehydrate and simmer to release their signature soft gel, prized in soups and desserts.

40 g per bag.

fields.name: Lentinula edodes / Shiitake (Dried Slices)
fields.short_description: Thick-cut dried shiitake slices from hardwood-log cultivation.
fields.description:
Log-grown shiitake sliced to a consistent 4 mm and dried slowly, concentrating guanylate flavour compounds and lentinan.

100 g per bag.

fields.name: Ganoderma lucidum / Reishi (Sliced Fruit Body)
fields.short_description: Pre-sliced reishi fruit body for long-simmer teas.
fields.description:
Mature reishi fruit bodies cut into thin, even slices so they can be simmered directly without grinding.

100 g per bag.

fields.name: Ganoderma lucidum / Reishi (Dual Extract)
fields.short_description: Hot-water and alcohol dual extract concentrating beta-glucans and triterpenes.
fields.description:
A 1:2 dual extract made from fruiting-body reishi: hot-water extraction for beta-glucans followed by ethanol extraction for triterpenes, recombined into a single liquid.

60 ml amber glass bottle with dropper. Each lot ships with batch documentation.

fields.name: Grifola frondosa / Maitake (Dual Extract)
fields.short_description: Dual extract of maitake fruiting bodies standardised for beta-glucan content.
fields.description:
Made from log-grown maitake fruiting bodies, extracted in hot water and ethanol to capture both polysaccharide and lipophilic fractions.

60 ml amber glass bottle with dropper.

fields.name: Hericium erinaceus / Lion's Mane (Dual Extract)
fields.short_description: Dual extract capturing both water-soluble beta-glucans and alcohol-soluble hericenones.
fields.description:
Lion's Mane fruiting bodies extracted in two stages so the final liquid contains beta-glucans as well as hericenones, the compounds most often studied in neurotrophic research.

60 ml amber glass bottle with dropper.

fields.name: Phellinus linteus / Meshima (Dual Extract)
fields.short_description: A rare, polysaccharide-rich dual extract of Meshima, produced in small batches.
fields.description:
Meshima is one of the rarest polypores in the catalog. Each small batch is extracted in hot water and ethanol and concentrated to a rich, dark tincture.

60 ml amber glass bottle with dropper.

fields.name: Inonotus obliquus / Chaga (Micronized Extract)
fields.short_description: Water-soluble chaga extract powder, micronized for easy dispersion.
fields.description:
A concentrated hot-water chaga extract spray-dried and micronized so it dissolves readily in warm liquids.

60 g resealable pouch.

fields.name: Lentinula edodes / Shiitake (Micronized Powder)
fields.short_description: Fine shiitake fruiting body powder for cooking and extraction work.
fields.description:
Whole shiitake fruit bodies milled to a fine powder below 80 mesh. Suited to seasoning blends and as a feedstock for extraction.

100 g resealable pouch.

fields.name: Agaricus blazei (Mycelial Biomass)
fields.short_description: Fermented mycelial biomass powder of Agaricus blazei.
fields.description:
Produced by submerged fermentation of Agaricus blazei mycelium, then dried and milled. Provides a consistent, fruit-body-free reference material.

80 g resealable pouch.

fields.name: Ganoderma lucidum (Cracked Spore Powder)
fields.short_description: Mechanically cracked reishi spores with the chitin wall broken open.
fields.description:
Reishi spores collected during peak sporulation and mechanically cracked to break the resistant chitin shell, exposing the contents for extraction.

30 g sealed sachet.

fields.name: Cordyceps militaris (Micronized Extract)
fields.short_description: Micronized cordyceps extract standardised for cordycepin content.
fields.description:
A hot-water and ethanol cordyceps extract, dried and micronized, with cordycepin verified by HPLC on each lot.

50 g resealable pouch.

fields.name: Pleurotus ostreatus 'Blue Oyster' (Spore Print)
fields.short_description: Foil-wrapped blue oyster spore print for microscopy and study.
fields.description:
A clean, single-fruit spore print deposited on sterile foil, ideal for spore morphology studies under the microscope.

Supplied for microscopy and educational use.

fields.name: Stropharia rugosoannulata 'Wine Cap' (Spore Syringe)
fields.short_description: 10 ml sterile syringe of wine cap spores in solution.
fields.description:
Wine cap spores suspended in sterile distilled water and loaded into a 10 ml syringe. Spore density is verified by haemocytometer count.

Sealed and gamma-clean packaged.

fields.name: Hericium erinaceus (Spore Syringe)
fields.short_description: 10 ml sterile syringe of Lion's Mane spores for microscopy.
fields.description:
Lion's Mane spores in a 10 ml sterile syringe, prepared under laminar flow. Ideal for spore analysis and documentation.

Store refrigerated on arrival.

fields.name: Coprinus comatus / Shaggy Mane (Spore Print)
fields.short_description: Wild-collected shaggy mane spore print, ready for slide preparation.
fields.description:
Shaggy mane caps deliquesce within hours, so this print was taken in the field at first cap opening and sealed immediately.

Supplied for microscopy and educational use.

fields.name: Hericium erinaceus (Liquid Culture Isolate)
fields.short_description: 12 ml isolate liquid culture of a vigorous Lion's Mane strain.
fields.description:
An isolated, fast-colonising Lion's Mane strain in nutrient broth, cultured for 14 days and inspected before dispatch.

12 ml syringe. Ships in insulated packaging.

fields.name: Cordyceps militaris (Liquid Culture Isolate)
fields.short_description: 12 ml liquid culture isolate of a high-cordycepin Cordyceps strain.
fields.description:
A stable, high-fruiting Cordyceps militaris isolate maintained in nutrient broth with routine contamination screening.

12 ml syringe. Ships in insulated packaging.

fields.name: Pleurotus ostreatus (Liquid Culture)
fields.short_description: Fast, forgiving oyster mushroom liquid culture for first-time inoculation.
fields.description:
Oyster mushrooms are among the most vigorous cultivars, making this liquid culture a good starting point for new cultivators.

10 ml syringe.

fields.name: Blue Oyster Ready-to-Fruit Kit
fields.short_description: Fully colonised blue oyster block that fruits within 7-10 days of opening.
fields.description:
Open the box, cut the flap, mist twice daily and harvest clusters of blue oyster mushrooms in about a week. Blocks commonly yield two to three flushes.

Ships fully colonised in a breathable filter-patch bag.

fields.name: Lion's Mane Fruiting Block
fields.short_description: Colonised hardwood block that fruits shaggy white Lion's Mane spines.
fields.description:
A hardwood-sawdust block fully colonised by Hericium erinaceus. Keep humidity high and fresh air moving to grow pillowy white spines in 10-14 days.

Includes misting bottle and quick-start guide.

fields.name: Shiitake Log Kit (Plug Spawn & Wax)
fields.short_description: Everything needed to inoculate hardwood logs with shiitake plug spawn.
fields.description:
Includes 100 shiitake plug spawn dowels, cheese wax and a daubing applicator. Logs typically begin fruiting after 6-12 months and continue for several years.

Logs are not included.

fields.name: FOG Proprietary Agar Matrix (MEA-P)
fields.short_description: Malt extract agar with peptone, optimised for fast mycelial expansion.
fields.description:
A malt extract agar enriched with peptone and trace minerals, formulated to speed radial growth and suppress bacterial contamination.

250 g powder makes about 10 litres of medium.

fields.name: Potato Dextrose Agar Plates (10-pack)
fields.short_description: Ten pre-poured, sterile 90 mm potato dextrose agar plates.
fields.description:
Pre-poured PDA plates that are sterility-tested and vacuum sealed in sleeves of ten. Ready to use for isolating cultures and transfers.

Store at 4 degrees C. Best used within 90 days.

fields.name: Sterilized Grain Matrix (Rye/Sorghum)
fields.short_description: Pressure-sterilised rye and sorghum grain in a self-healing injection port bag.
fields.description:
A 3 lb bag of hydrated, pressure-cooked rye and sorghum grain blend with a self-healing injection port. Ready for liquid culture or agar transfers.

Ships within 48 hours of sterilisation.

fields.name: Supplemented Hardwood Fruiting Substrate (5 lb)
fields.short_description: Masters-mix style hardwood sawdust and soy hull fruiting substrate.
fields.description:
A 50/50 blend of hardwood fuel pellets and soy hulls, hydrated to field capacity, in a 5 lb filter-patch bag. Ready to sterilise and inoculate.

Suited to oyster, Lion's Mane and shiitake.

fields.name: Mycology Microscopy Slide Kit
fields.short_description: Slides, cover slips, stain and a pipette set for spore and hyphae study.
fields.description:
Includes 50 glass slides, 100 cover slips, Melzer's reagent, cotton blue stain, dropper pipettes and a laminated spore-shape reference card.

Designed for use with a 400x compound microscope.

fields.name: Sterile Scalpel & Inoculation Loop Set
fields.short_description: Individually wrapped sterile scalpels and inoculation loops.
fields.description:
Ten individually wrapped stainless steel scalpel blades and ten disposable inoculation loops, gamma-sterilised for agar work.

Single use.

fields.name: FOG Lab Protocol: Substrate Optimization Field Manual
fields.short_description: Printed laboratory field manual covering substrate formulations, hydration ratios and yield observations.
fields.description:
A professionally printed FOG laboratory field manual documenting substrate formulations, hydration targets, sterilisation observations and yield records across multiple cultivated species.

Includes 42 pages of reference material with space for handwritten observations and experiment notes. Printed on durable, laboratory-friendly paper and supplied in a protective sleeve.

fields.name: FOG Lab Protocol: Culture Preservation Field Manual
fields.short_description: Bound laboratory reference manual for culture preservation, storage and viability documentation.
fields.description:
A 28-page printed laboratory reference manual focused on long-term fungal culture preservation, storage conditions, viability testing and recovery documentation.

Designed as a durable bench reference for researchers and hobby laboratories, with dedicated pages for recording culture identifiers, storage conditions and revival observations.

fields.name: FOG Field Guide: Identifying Medicinal Polypores
fields.short_description: Illustrated printed field guide covering reishi, turkey tail, chaga and other polypores.
fields.description:
A 60-page illustrated field guide designed for field observation and mushroom identification. Covers distinguishing characteristics, spore print colours, host trees, seasonal timing and common look-alikes for twelve polypore species.

Printed in a compact field-friendly format with a durable soft cover, making it suitable for carrying during woodland surveys and specimen documentation.

fields.name: Fomitopsis officinalis / Agarikon (Wild Conk)
fields.short_description: Retired wild-harvest agarikon conk. No longer available.
fields.description:
A wild-harvested old-growth agarikon conk lot that has been retired from the catalog. Kept here for order history and reference.

No longer sold.
